pr_title: Rerun mobile target jobs when it fails for 4 known scenarios
pr_body:
The 4 known scenarios are
- 78 - PACKAGE_INSTALLATION_FAILURE
- 81 - DEVICE_NOT_FOUND
- 85 - ADB_DEVICE_ENUMERATION_FAILURE
- 86 - PACKAGE_INSTALLATION_TIMEOUT

More details regarding to the above exit code could be found at https://github.com/dotnet/xharness/blob/main/src/Microsoft.DotNet.XHarness.Common/CLI/ExitCode.cs

Fixes #59679

The first two have error message `Can't find service: package`. In the log of the last failed test, I see a lot of messages indicating the emulator wasn't in a good shape, for example, `The device will be inoperable until the display size becomes available.` Thus, I believe these 3 test failures also caused by unstable Android emulator. @premun Is there a way to catch these emulator issues and rerun them automatically within the same build?

> @fanyang-mono 
> Is there a way to catch these emulator issues and rerun them automatically within the same build?

It already is happening
https://github.com/dotnet/arcade/blob/27d286184f0ab35a2a252929a04fbb2fe3c57dde/src/Microsoft.DotNet.Helix/Sdk/tools/xharness-runner/xharness-helix-job.android.ps1#L70-L74
however it won't work for your scenario because you don't float this exit code outside of the Xunit runner.

We need to signal the Helix SDK that this occurred like we spoke about last week by creating these `.retry` and `.reboot` files and then checking on the existence of these in your test setup and failing fast.

However, this only works for Apple, I will add the support for these in Android as well.

You could also have this?
```suggestion
            File.WriteAllText(fileName, $"appName: {appName}; exitCode: {exitCode}");
```
I don't need that. Check out the doc here: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.io.streamwriter?view=net-5.0
Yeah, I just thought it's less code? Or what is the upside of using `StreamWriter`? (just curious)

WriteAllText is a wrapper of StreamWriter. StreamWriter gives you more control. I think that I am okay with one more line here. We may need to add more stuff to the log file in the future and this is easier to expand.
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/17380506/filestream-vs-system-io-file-writealltext-when-writing-to-files

Many of these could technically also happen for the other commands, I would just drop the `install` requirements.

```suggestion
                            if (exitCode == 78 || exitCode == 81 || exitCode == 85 || exitCode == 86)
```
This function will only be called during installation and uninstallation. I don't think that we need to retry when uninstallation is failed, right?
Ah, ok, if it's only called for these two than leave as is
